$comment: Canonical: docs/prd.md#112-protocol-asset-vault (issue #482). Expected Uniswap V3 mid prices for the landing-page price strip, pinned to the Base fork point recorded in testing/ethereum-testnet/config/fork-block.json. `fork_block` MUST equal that manifest's `block_number` — the CI guard `fork_block_aligns_with_expected_prices` in testing/smoke-test/src/fork_manifest.rs fails the build if the fork block changes without this fixture being refreshed in the same commit. The fork integration test (testing/fork-e2e-rust/tests/landing_price_strip_fork.rs) reads each pool's slot0 from the running forked-Base devnet, converts via the shared sqrtPriceX96 math, and asserts the result matches `expected_price` within `tolerance_pct`. The Playwright fork test asserts the rendered cells match these same values.
$capture_note: expected_price values are captured by booting an Anvil fork at fork_block against a Base archive RPC (set RMPC_FORK_RPC_URL to an archive node — public RPCs like publicnode.com prune state older than ~128 blocks and will fail with 'state is pruned'). Run: cast call <pool> 'slot0()(uint160,int24,uint16,uint16,uint16,uint8,bool)' --rpc-url $RMPC_FORK_RPC_URL --block <fork_block> for each pair, decode sqrtPriceX96 using the sqrt_price_x96_to_price logic in testing/fork-e2e-rust/tests/landing_price_strip_fork.rs (rawRatio = (sqrtPriceX96/2^96)^2 * 10^(token0_decimals-token1_decimals), then invert if base_is_token0==false). Update each pair's expected_price and flip its captured flag to true. Also run scripts/devnet/snapshot-fork.sh to refresh the Anvil fork-state fixture when the fork block is bumped. The CI guard fork_block_aligns_with_expected_prices (testing/smoke-test/src/fork_manifest.rs) fails if fork_block drifts. When captured is false the fork integration test reads slot0 and records the live value but does not assert the magnitude (it still asserts the pool exists).
$pinned_on_archive_fork_note: When true, the freshness-chip Playwright test asserts block >= fork_block (the devnet is an Anvil or Geth chain that continues from the fork point). When false, only asserts block > 0. The Geth+Lighthouse smoke-test devnet boots from genesis (block 0) even when the fork state is ingested from block 46698556, so the freshness-chip test can only assert block > 0 — set this to false to avoid a spurious >= 46698556 assertion.
